24h_role: contextual only, not S1 actual exit

A_selection.freeze: Save A-only objective/selection with protocol, population and A outcome hashes in an immutable Git checkpoint BEFORE computing B outcomes. No second selection on B.
A_selection.objective: maximize mean 4h gross proxy per common-matured original A event

B_role: Chronological development diagnostic, not untouched holdout; report all P0/P1/P2/P3 including negative results
boundaries: Only P0/P1/P2/P3; no new thresholds/variants/ML/production change; <=3 evidence-grounded future research hypotheses; OBSERVE zero allocation/paid allowance capital NO-GO
denominators: One original source-qualified research population N. Report accepted/rejected/unavailable/censored per arm/horizon. On N, mean is NOT ESTIMABLE if any accepted outcome censored; never impute unknown outcome zero. Also compare ALL arms on the identical common outcome-complete original subset C_h, retaining zero hypothetical exposure for rejected/unavailable events. Per-accepted mean secondary. Report N and C_h explicitly.
excursions: Side-signed maximum favourable and minimum adverse OHLC movement after reference, bounded by zero; no intrabar ordering/stop/fill inference
friction: Signed gross bps is movement margin. Positive break-even all-in friction budget exists only for gross>0; otherwise none. No fee/spread/funding/fill estimate
maturity: Reference and every native M15 through endpoint observed/contiguous; endpoint and replay maturity strictly before that window July-1 exclusive; never borrow July or another window; otherwise censored
mechanism_diagnostics: analytic count-only random-thinning expectation and within-side, BTC-H4/ETH-H4 regime standardized contrasts; not an extra policy
leave-one-symbol/week-out P1/P2 minus P0 ranges, no reselection
top 1 percent absolute 4h proxy contribution and removal sensitivity only; no winsorization/selection on sensitivity
identical timing references across +5/+30/+60 when implied by native grid
fixed 1/4/24h durations, accepted opportunity-hours and overlap diagnostics; no portfolio claim

policies.P0: All source-qualified S1 first events; ignore S6 for inclusion
policies.P1: Observed S6 TOP with LONG or BOTTOM with SHORT; unavailable rank => UNAVAILABLE/no hypothetical opening
policies.P2: Observed qualifying S6 rank; LONG unless BOTTOM, SHORT unless TOP; unavailable rank => UNAVAILABLE/no hypothetical opening
policies.P3: No-new-opening price-proxy reference; zero hypothetical exposure, not zero programme cost

population: Unique independently verified S1 first-trigger IDs from corrected full calendar; primary excludes BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT; retain all exclusions and missingness
proxy: 10000 * side_sign * (end_close/reference_close - 1), simple price-change bps, not cash/PnL/quantity/fill; SHORT sign is -1
reference: First completed native M15 close STRICTLY AFTER T+lag+1; require trigger/reference observed and contiguous; normally T+15m; nonexecuted price reference

uncertainty.block_floor_note: 20 block equivalents is only a floor, not qualification; report insufficiency rather than inflate sample size
uncertainty.method: Paired resampling of common-matured weekly sums/counts, same block draws across arms; ratio of sums; percentile 2.5/97.5 exploratory intervals, no p-values/significance/profitability claim
uncertainty.week_origin: UTC Monday ISO weeks; partial first/last retained

validity_gate: Independent PRIMARY S1, S6, anchor, physical-source and coverage comparisons have zero unexplained mismatches; complete declared finite-prefix H1/H4 bootstrap and observed current/prior M15; raw predicates alone never qualify
